description: This file defines the 'ShopSection' result class for a database schema using Moose and DBIx::Class. It specifies table name, columns, primary key, unique constraints, relationships to other tables, and includes a method to determine if a shop section is deletable based on associated articles.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::ShopSection
classes.description: A DBIx::Class result class representing a shop section in the database schema, with relationships to projects and articles, and a method to check if it can be deleted.

methods.name: deletable
methods.description: Determines if the shop section can be deleted, based on whether it has associated articles or an article count.
